question: How is the second eight-petaled wheel described?
premises: dvitīyam aṣṭa patram tu teja dhyāna sudīpitam
the second eight-petaled wheel is mentioned
it is well illuminated by fire meditation
inference: The second eight-petaled wheel is well illuminated by fire meditation.
plain_english: The second eight-petaled wheel is well illuminated by fire meditation.
